OBSERVED so far:
- DDP built at train_rqvae.py:350 with find_unused_parameters=False, broadcast_buffers=False, AFTER init_codebook? No: init_codebook at :410 is AFTER DDP construction; they compensate with dist.broadcast of every level's codebook at :418-419 plus dist.barrier at :420.
- VQLayer.__init__ layers.py:69-84 sets self.embed.weight.requires_grad_(False) when frechet is on, so the codebook is excluded from the DDP reducer (avoids the find_unused_parameters=False second-step death).
- Per-step collectives in the trainer: 3x all_reduce(unused_codes 'used') inside VQLayer.forward layers.py:166 (one per residual level); then 3x2 all_reduce(tangent_sum, weight_sum) at train_rqvae.py:456-457; per-epoch 2x all_reduce at :469-470. All are inside rank-symmetric control flow so far.
- Codebook step is a manual .data write (model.py:80 layer.get_code_embs().data.copy_(moved)) after reducing the per-slot sums, so all ranks apply the identical update.
OPEN: (a) verify the eval branch (_skip_ddp_reduce, rank-0-only get_indices, barrier) cannot desynchronise collectives; (b) the Frechet.distances memory shape B x K x D on the all-items export pass; (c) VQLayer.init_codebook passes raw Euclidean residual into frechet.distances (layers.py:199-200) - check whether that saturates; (d) read remaining tests.

STEP 2 (result). Read tests/test_ddp.py, tests/test_mechanism.py, tests/test_codebook_step.py.
FINDINGS:
(1) Distributed execution PASS. Collectives named and symmetric: per forward, 3x all_reduce('used') at layers.py:165-166 (one per residual level); per step after optimizer.step, 3x2 all_reduce(tangent_sum/weight_sum) at train_rqvae.py:455-457; per epoch 2x all_reduce(loss/recon) at :468-470; barriers at :420 and :517; the level-wise dist.broadcast of the initial codebook at :418-419 plus the per-level broadcast of KMeans centres at layers.py:191-192. The rank-0-only eval/export pass is protected by the _skip_ddp_reduce flag set on ALL ranks (train_rqvae.py:486-487, 514-515) so no rank enters one side of an all_reduce. find_unused_parameters=False is safe because layers.py:84 sets embed.weight.requires_grad_(False) before DDP is constructed (train_rqvae.py:346-351), so the manually updated codebook is never in the reducer; encoder+decoder both receive gradient (straight-through x_q = x + (x_q-x).detach() and the curved commitment).
(2) Shared state NEEDS_FIX (blocking): VQLayer.init_codebook layers.py:198-201 calls self.frechet.distances(x, codebook) with x = a TANGENT residual (raw encoder output at level 1), not a ball point, contradicting its own docstring 'same cost and same residual as the training step' (the training step does clamp_ball(exp_0(latent)) first, layers.py:153). With ||x||>1 the mobius_add denominator makes the difference norm exceed 1 for essentially every code, atanh is clamped at 1-1e-7 and poincare_distance returns the same saturated 16.118 for all 256 slots -> argmin degenerates to index 0 for every item, at every level. Worked example in the report.
(3) minor: frechet_poincare.py:141 normalises weights by the PER-RANK batch mean, so the reduced weighted mean uses w_i/c_rank and the 4-rank estimator differs from the single-process one when rank batch means differ. Small (LLN over 1024 items) but real.
Still open: could not run torch (no shell/no torch in sandbox); the init defect is proven algebraically, not by execution.

(b) trainer builds DDP at train_rqvae.py:350 with find_unused_parameters=False, broadcast_buffers=False; init_codebook (KMeans) is called on every rank at :410 AFTER DDP construction, then each level's code embs are broadcast from rank 0 at :418-420 and a barrier at :420. (c) codebook step: frechet_step_sums (:451) -> dist.all_reduce SUM on tangent_sum and weight_sum per level (:456-457) -> apply_frechet_codebook_step writes via .data.copy_ (:459, model.py:80). direction = sum_r sum_i w tau / sum_r sum_i w (global weighted Frechet mean) — the right reduction. (d) a per-step all_reduce of code usage counts runs inside VQLayer.forward every level (layers.py:165-166) and is suppressed by _skip_ddp_reduce for the rank-0-only eval/export passes (train_rqvae.py:486-487, 544-545).

STAGE 2 — collective audit.
Goal: enumerate every collective and check rank symmetry / reachability.
Read: grep of all collectives across the tree.
Observed, per training step (train_rqvae.py:435-460): 3x all_reduce(used) inside VQLayer.forward (layers.py:165-166, one per residual level), DDP's gradient all_reduce inside backward, then 6x all_reduce in the codebook step (train_rqvae.py:456-457, tangent_sum and weight_sum per level). All unconditional inside the batch loop; the list "sums" is non-empty on every rank because item_ids is always passed (train_rqvae.py:439 -> layers.py:148 curved=True) so remember() always sets _last. Per epoch: 2x all_reduce of loss/recon (469-470). At init: broadcast(centers,0) per level (layers.py:192), executed by all ranks because init_codebook is called by every rank at train_rqvae.py:410, not only rank 0; then broadcast(code_embs,0) x3 and a barrier (418-420). Barriers at 420/517/566 run on all ranks. The rank-0-only eval (491-496) and export (544-551) passes run with _skip_ddp_reduce=True, which is set on all ranks (486-487, 514-515), so there is no rank-0-only collective.
DistributedSampler(drop_last=False) gives every rank the same ceil(N/4/1024) batches, so collective counts match.
Also verified: VQLayer sets embed.weight.requires_grad_(False) at layers.py:84 whenever the frechet path exists, and frechet_codebook is hard-wired True at train_rqvae.py:255, so the DDP reducer never owns an unreduced parameter (this is the defect the class comment at layers.py:79-83 says it avoids).
The .data.copy_ write at model.py:80 happens only after the sums are all_reduced, so every rank writes an identical tensor.
Open: decide whether per-rank (vs global-batch) weight normalisation is a defect or the proposal's own per-batch definition; then write the report.
